null_case_scope: With all native guards enabled, NULL source is refused by tournament_place_settlement_batches_check1 and NULL user_id by tournament_obligations_check1. These prove existing-constraint refusal and exact rollback. The new verifier NULL branches were source-reviewed, not reached by bypassing those constraints.
spin_fixture_correction: Native calculator uses 80/20 at 10x; prior fixture supplied 100%-winner for both 2x and 10x and required one payout. The fixture now supplies the matching 10x contract, derives exact recipient amounts/count from the immutable funded receipt, and independently checks the native calculator, total payouts and custody.

earlier_spin_failure.assessment: The discovered 10x fixture mismatch explains a concrete failure path; the original generic failed run did not capture its multiplier, so direct attribution of that particular run remains an inference.

deterministic_ten_attempt.note: Single-tier selection was rejected by the actual native validator before drawing. The unsupported runner option was removed. No production draw function was changed and no 10x success is claimed.

limits: Synthetic opening custody/standings; registration was not exercised. Paid-before amounts and all payouts used actual native financial functions, not synthetic paid receipts or batches.
